instruction: Candid documentary medium shot of an indoor office lounge. An older woman with short white hair (R2) in a gray blazer sits on the left of a black leather sofa, gesturing with both hands open as she speaks. Beside her, a bearded man in a gray plaid suit (R1) sits on the right, holding a white paper and listening to her. A wooden coffee table with a laptop is in the foreground under soft indoor lighting.
